MIND. [1] [Anac. oc.]
Loss of will ; cannot control voluntary muscles. θ Paralysis with imbecility.
Did not know his surroundings. θ Paralysis with imbecility.
Weak memory.
Difficult thinking.
Melancholy.
Hypochondriasis.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Anac. oc.]
Apathy or anesthesia.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Anac. oc.]
Head falls forward, difficult to keep it up. θ Paralysis and imbecility.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Anac. oc.]
Erysipelas over whole face (from applying juice to destroy marks).
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Anac. oc.]
Cannot speak, only mutters unintelligible sounds. θ Paralysis and imbecility.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Anac. oc.]
Respiration free. θ Paralysis and imbecility.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Anac. oc.]
Pulse slow, moderately full, 60. θ Paralysis with imbecility.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Anac. oc.]
A woman, æt. 70, lost two grown-up children who died in the insane asylum ; ulcers on the leg and attacks of vertigo so that she fell from chair ; a year ago had what was called an apoplectic-attack. θ Paralysis with imbecility.
